_readme: Every key must name a real Config field in utils_text_finetune.py (typos are hard errors).
- test  : tiny caps, 1 epoch — plumbing only, ~1 min per cell.
- demo  : full backbones, moderate caps, 2 epochs — real-ish numbers in <30 min per cell.
- full  : no caps, 4 epochs (ParlaSent paper settings) — the weekend run.
- custom: bring your own overrides in modes.custom.
Backbones (set via engine CLI --backbone or defaults in utils_text_finetune.BACKBONES):
Mixtures (set via engine CLI --mixture, choose from utils_text_finetune.MIXTURES):
S=parlasent_sl, P=parlaspeech_si, R=rog_dia, then pairs SP/SR/PR, and triple SPR
mixture_overrides: applied AFTER modes[run_mode], so S can get 10 epochs under 'full'
while leaving the multi-source mixtures at 4. Matches the ParlaSent paper's recipe
(10 epochs monolingual, 4 multilingual, Mochtak et al. 2023).
